variables.name: appointment_booked
variables.description: True only if the caller said yes to the follow-up callback offer

variables.name: interest_level
variables.description: The caller's level of interest in the follow-up callback offer, or in the ride itself if declined

tools.name: save_closing_interest
tools.description: Save whether the caller wants a follow-up callback about running AI Chauffeur, and their interest level.

instruction.text:
First say: 'You just watched AI Chauffeur quote, catch a correction, and book the whole trip in one call — no hold, no missed call.' Then ask exactly: 'Want that running on your own line? Say yes and our team will follow up.' Wait for a yes or no answer. If the answer is unclear, off-topic, or doesn't resolve to yes or no, ask that exact question once more, plainly - then accept whatever the caller says next and proceed with it, without asking a third time.
If the answer resolves to yes, say exactly: 'Perfect.'
If the answer resolves to no (or an unclear answer is being treated as no after the second attempt), say exactly: 'No problem.'
Say nothing else after that line - a closing line follows separately in the next step.
Base appointment_booked and interest_level strictly on the caller's answer to this question - never on anything said earlier in the call, such as their feedback answer.
Use the save_closing_interest tool once, with appointment_booked set to true only for a yes answer, and interest_level capturing how interested the caller sounded.

transition_condition.prompt: The caller has resolved the callback offer to yes or no, or, after being asked once more, given any further answer
The caller has given any answer, however brief or off-topic, to the feedback question

instruction.text: Ask exactly: 'Before you go — what did you think of AI Chauffeur?' Wait for the caller's answer, however brief or detailed, and capture it word for word - do not paraphrase, judge, or ask a follow-up question about it. Give at most a short natural acknowledgment (e.g. 'Thanks for that.') and then stop - the next question is asked separately. Immediately after the caller answers, use the save_demo_feedback tool once, passing their verbatim answer to this specific question - never the desk's own prior lines (like a booking confirmation) or anything said elsewhere in the call.

tools.description: Save the caller's verbatim feedback about the demo.
tools.name: save_demo_feedback

variables.name: demo_feedback
variables.description: The caller's answer, captured word for word, describing what they thought of the demo

instruction.text: Thanks for calling AI Chauffeur — we answer twenty-four seven, first ring, never a missed call, never a voicemail.
